title: UAE says investigation launched into flydubai incident

blocks.text: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates – The United Arab Emirates’ chief prosecutor on Thursday said an investigation had been launched into the incident on board a flydubai flight to Israel, including the possibility of “terrorist activity or intent”. The state news agency WAM said the attorney general had ordered the probe, adding that “the investigation team has launched its work into the incident” that forced the plane to land in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday.
